title: LoomNativeSearchIndexingAndRetrieval
clause: Rebuild Loom full-text, fuzzy, faceted and semantic retrieval through bounded Surreal-native indexes and queries.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main Loom search, knowledge retrieval, vector, caption/transcript and UI surfaces.
Measure current result semantics and query cardinality; classify Rust-side scans and N+1 fetches.
stop_conditions: Search permission filtering would occur after candidate retrieval.
Vector or text index configuration is unspecified or cannot be proven on real SurrealDB.

scope.summary: Provide one scoped search substrate across notes, code, documents, crawled images and creative assets while respecting module authority and project boundaries.
forbidden_paths: Whole-workspace in-memory filtering for ordinary search
N+1 record hydration without a documented bound
Search index as mutable source authority
acceptance_criteria: Full-text, prefix/fuzzy, tag/folder/type/date/location/source facets and semantic-vector retrieval use declared Surreal indexes and bounded deterministic queries.
Every result carries canonical source identity, project, domain kind, relevance explanation, provenance and scope without copying domain-authoritative content unnecessarily.
Authorization predicates apply before candidate materialization; counts, facets, snippets and ranking cannot reveal denied resources.
Index update, deletion, tombstone, rebuild and restart semantics converge from canonical Surreal records and EventLedger/outbox state.
Native search UI supports query, filters, pagination, empty/degraded/rebuilding states and keyboard navigation with stable Argus identifiers.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal text/vector/facet tests with multi-project and denied-resource fixtures.
Capture query plans and bounded-query budgets for large synthetic-but-real database fixtures.
Run index corruption/rebuild/restart proof and Argus search-state matrix.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private items do not influence shared-project counts, facets, snippets or ranks.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged filters/cursors cannot search another account or project.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Index, embedding, snippet and result visibility cannot exceed canonical source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation removes items from new queries and invalidates stale cursors/subscriptions.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote search documents remain quarantined until locally authorized.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Counts, facets, rank shifts, timing, suggestions and typo correction do not reveal denied resources.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: query, rebuild, retry, denial and result-count-safe events
index version, lag, rebuild and bounded-query health
search/UI hang correlation without query-content leakage

risk_if_missed: Loom cannot connect large creative and IDE datasets efficiently, or search leaks restricted resources through metadata.

risks: Native query still hydrates the workspace in Rust.
Vector and text ranking diverge unpredictably.

sources: Official SurrealDB search and vector documentation
research_provenance.selected_approach: Declared Surreal text/vector indexes, bounded scoped queries and reconstructable derived index state.
